toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Beweeg' is normally intransitive; 'nie vanself beweeg nie' is the natural Afrikaans for 'cannot move on its own'.
toegepas.fout: 'kan homself nie beweeg nie' is a stiff reflexive construction.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'kan nie vanself beweeg nie' is the natural Afrikaans for moving on its own, with the same meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The reflexive 'hulleself skuif' is wooden; 'nie self skuif nie' says the same thing naturally.
toegepas.fout: 'kan hulleself nie skuif nie' is a wooden reflexive.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'kan nie self skuif nie' says the same thing naturally and does not repeat 'vanself' from the sentence before.

toegepas.voor: Daardie spiere is die dele wat werk en die bene laat beweeg
toegepas.na: Daardie spiere doen die werk en laat die bene beweeg
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die dele wat werk' is vague and wooden; a direct verb reads more clearly with the same meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'die dele wat werk' is vague and flat.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A direct verb keeps the contrast (muscles are the active part) and reads more clearly, with the same meaning.

toegepas.voor: So kom daardie been in beweging en die dier se lyf skuif saam
toegepas.na: So kom daardie been in beweging, en die dier se lyf beweeg saam
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb; 'skuif saam' usually means 'move up closer together', so 'beweeg saam' avoids the wrong reading.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses, and 'skuif saam' can be read as 'move closer together'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required and 'beweeg saam' removes the misreading without changing what the sentence says.

toegepas.voor: 'n Spier kan net trek en hy kan nooit stoot nie
toegepas.na: 'n Spier kan net trek, en hy kan nooit stoot nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both halves have a subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 requires the comma.

toegepas.voor: Jou elmboog is so 'n gewrig en jou arm
toegepas.na: Jou elmboog is so 'n gewrig, en jou arm
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Jou elmboog is' and 'jou arm kan' are separate clauses, so the comma is required.

toegepas.voor: laat buig nie en gewrigte alleen ook nie
toegepas.na: laat buig nie, en gewrigte alleen kan dit ook nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: The elliptical second half is awkward to read; giving it its own verb and the AWS comma makes the two-part statement clear.
toegepas.fout: The verbless elliptical second half makes a Grade 5 reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Giving the second half its own verb and the AWS comma makes the two-part statement clear without moving the meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subjects; the protected words 'en geen been skuif nie' stay untouched.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subjects and verbs.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'geen been skuif nie' is a full clause, and the protected words stay intact after the comma.

toegepas.voor: Die gewrigte gee die plekke waar die bene kan swaai as 'n spier trek
toegepas.na: Die gewrigte is die plekke waar die bene kan swaai wanneer 'n spier trek
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Gee die plekke' is wooden, and 'wanneer' is clearer than 'as', which a learner can read as 'like'.
toegepas.fout: 'gee die plekke' is wooden, and 'as' could be misread as 'like'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'is die plekke' matches the lesson's own definition of a joint, and 'wanneer' is clearer while keeping the meaning.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A muscle 'bult uit' in Afrikaans; 'bult op' is not the usual expression.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'opbult' is a standard Afrikaans verb for bulging, so the swap to 'uitbult' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.voor: sy vlerke af en op trek
laat_vaar.na: sy vlerke op en af trek
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The fixed Afrikaans pair is 'op en af'; drop this if the down-first order was deliberate.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'af en op' is acceptable Afrikaans, and the down-first order may be deliberate because the breast muscles power the downstroke, so swapping it changes the order of actions.

vlae.teks: By baie van hierdie gewrigte kan die bene teen mekaar beweeg.
vlae.rede: 'Teen mekaar beweeg' can be read as the bones rubbing against each other or as moving relative to each other; left unchanged because choosing between them means guessing the intended content.
